master.definition_en: Conversion disorder is a disorder in which a person experiences blindness, paralysis, or other symptoms affecting the nervous system that cannot be explained solely by a physical illness or injury. Symptoms usually begin suddenly after a period of emotional or physical distress or psychological conflict. Conversion disorder is thought to be caused by the bodys reaction to a stressful physical or emotional event. Some research has identified potential neurological changes that may be related to symptoms of the disorder. Diagnosis of conversion disorder is based on identifying particular signs that are common among people with the disorder, as well as performing tests to rule out other causes of the symptoms. Treatment may include psychotherapy, hypnosis, and stress management training to help reduce symptoms. Treatment of any underlying psychological disorder is also recommended. The affected body part may require physical or occupational therapy until symptoms resolve.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 绝大多数患者呈急性自限性经过并获得终生免疫，不会慢性化；但高龄老人及合并慢性乙肝/丙肝、肝硬化基础的患者，感染甲肝后有较高风险诱发暴发性急性肝衰竭（数天至数周内危及生命）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 呈自限性临床治愈（无慢性携带状态），治疗以休息、营养支持与护肝降酶为主；接种甲肝疫苗可提供近100%的长期免疫保护。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO估算全球每年约150万例临床甲肝病例（实际隐性感染超1亿例）；2016年WHO估算甲肝直接导致约7,134例死亡（占全球病毒性肝炎死亡约0.5%）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 自2008年甲肝疫苗纳入国家免疫规划以来，中国甲肝发病率与死亡率断崖式下降（年报告死亡常为个位数）。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球每年临床病例约150万例，实际感染人次超1亿；卫生条件改善使发展中国家青少年与成人易感人群比例反升。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 儿童已实现高水平疫苗覆盖，当前散发病例多见于未接种疫苗的青壮年或因生食贝类海鲜引起的局部食源性暴发。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：若甲肝患者黄疸（皮肤眼白发黄）迅速加深的同时，出现极度乏力、频繁呕吐不能进食、烦躁胡言乱语或嗜睡（肝性脑病前兆）、牙龈/皮肤瘀斑出血（凝血障碍），立即送医抢救！严禁盲目服用成分不明的“保肝偏方/草药”（加重药物性肝损伤）或饮酒；急诊立即查凝血酶原活动度（PTA/INR）与血氨，警惕急性肝衰竭。

严格消化道隔离（粪-口传播），患者餐具洗漱用品独立消毒，家庭密切接触者2周内可应急接种甲肝疫苗

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 国内已大规模应用自主研发的甲肝减毒活疫苗与灭活疫苗，联合甲乙肝联合疫苗及长效免疫持久性随访证实接种后保护抗体可持续20–30年以上；高敏RT-PCR快速检测试剂已用于贝类海产品与水源暴发溯源。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 成年未接种人群及慢性肝病患者补种意识不足，生食海鲜引起的局部暴发时有发生; 2) 尚无针对暴发性甲肝的特异性抗病毒药物; 3) 突发跨区域食源性暴发时的暴露后快速免疫球蛋白与疫苗应急储备调度。

master.definition_en: A non-metastasizing tumor that arises from the adenohypophysial cells of the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland. The tumor can be hormonally functioning or not. The diagnosis can be based on imaging studies and/or radioimmunoassays. Due to its location in the sella turcica, expansion of the tumor mass can impinge on the optic chiasm or involve the temporal lobe, third ventricle and posterior fossa A frequently associated physical finding is bitemporal hemianopsia which may progress to further visual loss.

It has been reported in two kindreds (one of which contained 13 affected individuals spanning three generations) and in an unrelated individual. Some affected patients also showed bilateral partial flexion contractures of the fingers and toes, and webbing of the toes. The syndrome is inherited as an autosomal dominant trait.

It is most commonly located in the cerebellum, but occurrence in the hypothalamus, brain stem, optic chiasma, and hemispheres has also been reported.

In many cases, a second gastrointestinal malignancy is present.

master.definition_en: Acquired hemophilia is a bleeding disorder that interferes with the body's blood clotting process. Signs and symptoms include prolonged bleeding, frequent nosebleeds, bruising throughout the body, solid swellings of congealed blood (hematomas), hematuria, and gastrointestinal or urologic bleeding. Acquired hemophilia occurs when the body's immune system attacks and disables a certain protein that helps the blood clot. About half of the cases are associated with other conditions, such as pregnancy, autoimmune disease, cancer, skin diseases, or allergic reactions to medications.

master.definition_en: A congenital myopathy of the musculoskeletal system that covers a wide spectrum of phenotypes and is caused by pathogenic variants in the skeletal muscle beta-Tropomyosin gene. These variants lead to a variety of overlapping adult onset and congenital myopathies characterized by muscle weakness, amyotrophy, hypotonia, myopathic facies, scoliosis, and sometimes contractures among other phenotypes. Histologic findings on skeletal muscle biopsy are variable with nemaline and intranuclear bodies, cap-like lesions, core-like lesions, fiber-type disproportion, and dystrophic features all observed to some degree.
